summary: A mixed day led by judicial developments on judicial accountability and extradition enforcement, alongside major retail regulatory tightening and Reliance's $1.3 billion rupee bond raise ahead of potential listings.

bullets.text: Kerala High Court ruled Interpol arrest warrants cannot be ignored merely because no extradition request has been filed.
Reliance Industries to raise $1.3 billion through 5-year rupee bond sale, first major bond issuance since 2023.
Amazon expanding festive capacity with 20 new fulfilment centres, 6 sort centres, and 150 delivery stations spanning 118 cities.
India regulators intensifying scrutiny over misleading food product claims made by FMCG brands on packaging and marketing.
US Senate Republicans incorporated 126 substantive Democratic amendments into revised Clarity Act crypto bill ahead of critical vote.
